result:
Round 162 passes, with no bugs. Every row the task lists was checked in a real Chromium browser at 1440×900 and 1280×720 (`browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true). I changed no app source; the source hashes at the start and end of my phase are identical.

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| T162-TARGETED | The 19 test files pass 358/358, the same as A. The new LV1, LGH1, LC1 (audio and video halves) and LG2 tests are present and green. |
| SOURCE-SCOPE | HEAD is `f08c7ce`. The 969 frozen files match at start and end, and A's end hashes match. `git status` shows only the 11 granted files plus doc 131, so every protected file is unchanged. |
| AN-REVIEW | I read the diff myself. It changes exactly what the task lists in the three components and `strings.ts`, and nothing else. No test file lost an `expect(` (C recount). Doc 130 changes only its status line, and doc 131 has the required sections. |
| ICON-V3C2 | Checked in all 4 states at both viewports (details below). |
| RV1-V3C2 | With B's 6 key renames applied there are no missing keys, no added keys and no collisions, and the maximum shift is 0 px. |
| LANE-STATES-BOX | Every keyed element moved 0.000 px. The full import button is still 107×22. Only the inner title text moves: the group name by 0.344 px and the clip titles by 0.234 / 0.203 px, within B's predicted ≤ 0.35 px. |
| FUNC-SMOKE-LANE | Every click and drag landed on the icon itself (details below). |
| G162-3 | `/studio-lab` opens anonymously with the demo badge. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required", with no workspace and no audio sources. `/api/studio-token` returns 401, so premium auth is not bypassed. The fake-Bearer 403 check is blocked because the backend isn't available in the cloud. |
| PX-NET / REG-HYD | No forbidden requests, no Authorization headers, no hydration messages and no page errors. The only noise is the expected cart noise. |

**ICON-V3C2 details:**
- Each site has exactly one hidden icon of the planned type, size and stroke width.
- Icon colours follow their buttons, including on hover and on a selected clip.
- The fold and compact import icons are centred within 0.5 px.
- No old glyph text remains in any track header, group header or clip.
- Accessible names are as expected; both import buttons now read "Your own video".
- The empty video lane reads exactly "No video — use “Your own video” or drop a file here".

**FUNC-SMOKE-LANE details:**
- **Lane fold:** clicking the chevron folds and unfolds the lane. Space on the focused fold does the same and does not start playback.
- **Video import:** both the compact and the full button open a real file chooser. Choosing the test video places a 6.000 s clip.
- **Group:** clicking the fold chevron collapses and expands the group, and U still toggles it. Clicking the Layers icon selects the group.
- **Clip moves:** dragging from the grip icon or the film icon moves the clip by exactly the dragged time. One Ctrl+Z undoes the move.
- **Audio:** playback after the moves gives real output, with a peak of 0.7624.

Two previously deferred Lows close on this evidence. **C-R154-02:** the group name now renders only in Instrument Sans, with no DejaVu fallback. **GATE139-EMPTY-VIDEO-FORMATTER:** the empty-lane hint now reuses the same label as the import button.

I replaced two runs, and neither reflects on A's work:
- **Cold-load warm-up:** the first page load after the new icon imports gave the known "Invalid hook call" error. The second load was clean.
- **My own test script:** the first 1440 functional run had two mistakes in my checks. The group is already selected right after Ctrl+G, and the Undo title reads "Move clip" both before and after a second move. I fixed the checks and every later run was green.

The final numbers come from a second full run at both viewports, because the first run didn't save the raw measurements needed for one comparison. Both runs agree on every icon and functional result.

Notes for B, none of them bugs:
- The video file input accepts multiple files. This predates this round.
- A's reviewer found three leftovers for the polish pass: unused text-size classes on the icon-only buttons, test helpers that still strip ▣ (`.replace('▣','')`) and now do nothing, and docs 070 and 115 still describing the old glyphs.

Under the task's outcome rule, V-3c-2 becomes მზადაა once root publishes, and round 163 is V-3c-3 unless the regression round, due from 2026-10-27, comes first.
